description: Digital Ledger Technology - DarkNet is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. Several Experiments were performed under the Digital Ledger Technology project of the Darknet program. The experiments include those with normal conditions, faults, and cyber-events that are performed for at least 100 seconds. The set of experiments included in this folder is a sample of the experiments used in the report. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Electricity. Its keywords are cyber events, fault events, attestation. The portal shows 2024-05-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
